upload_instructions: Set the MIDI Inter-packet delay to 30 ms.
Hold FUNCTION during power-on and select TRIG 5 (MIDI UPGRADE).
Click 'Upload MIDI Upgrade File' below and pick the .syx file.
receive_instructions: Hold FUNCTION during power-on and select TRIG 6 (SEND UPGRADE).

bank_select_reset.description: Sent alongside Panic to reset bank selects.

joystick.description: `y_up`/`y_down` are unipolar axes measured from the stick's center. Moving through center sends the resting value on the opposite axis.

sequencer_modes.description: Sets the sequencer to Pattern mode (one loop) or Song mode (a chain of patterns).

local_control_toggle.description: Enables or disables the physical controls. When Off, the front panel does not trigger the internal sound engine, so an external sequencer cannot double-trigger it.

kit.note: The workspace is selected by `workspace_extra` (the `$53` third byte = `0x01`), so the device ignores this slot value. 64 matches the MD. A workspace dump answers with version `$40` instead of `$02` and carries an extra flag byte, pushing its payload from offset 10 to 11. `sysex_layout` describes the `$02` form.

status.note: Sending `query_cmd` with no sub-byte is a bare presence ping. The device answers with `reply_cmd` and no parameter.

write_arm.description: Arms the device to receive a kit/pattern/song dump. Payload: `[write_arm.cmd, write_arm_type, slot, 0x01]`. `write_arm_type` is per-kind, see `sysex_api.{kit,pattern,song}.write_arm_type`.
